walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Religious Studies specification.

An Introduction to Christian Ethics appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet An Introduction to Christian Ethics in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with An Introduction to Christian Ethics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
